title: Add the model-icon utility and its icon set

project.description: The Angular project to add the utility to.

path.description: Path where the utility is generated. Defaults to libs/prompt-kit.

assetsPath.description: Folder the icon SVGs are copied to; the app must serve it as static files. The helper's URLs follow it (public/model-icons is served at /model-icons). Defaults to public/model-icons.
